OpenAI Proposes Limits on AI Development, Suggests Progress Metric

OpenAI has called for common limits on artificial intelligence development and urged the industry to adopt 'perplexity' as a metric for measuring progress. This proposal aims to establish shared guidelines for the advancement of AI technology.
